features.title: What changes in the first week

rent.title: Rent collects itself
rent.body: Invoices go out on the 1st with a UPI link. Reminders follow on WhatsApp. Payments match to the right invoice without anyone checking a bank statement.

ops.title: Every bed, on one screen
ops.body: See who sleeps where across blocks and floors, move a resident with a drag, and check in a new one with DigiLocker KYC and a police verification form ready to file.

family.title: Residents and parents stay in the loop
family.body: Residents pay, skip meals and raise complaints from their phone. Parents approve leave on WhatsApp and see when their child comes in.

owner.title: Owner
owner.body: Collections, occupancy, profit and loss. Ask questions in plain English or Malayalam.

warden.title: Warden
warden.body: Complaints with SLAs, gate log, visitors, staff attendance and the day's headcount.

resident.title: Resident
resident.body: Pay rent, skip a meal, request leave, raise a complaint with a photo.

parent.title: Parent
parent.body: Approve leave, pay fees, and know when their child comes in or goes out.

items.title: Your hostel's data stays separate
items.body: Every row belongs to one hostel. Row-level security in the database decides who sees what, not just the app.

items.title: Each person sees their part
items.body: Residents see their own invoices and room. Parents see their child. Wardens don't see the profit and loss.

items.title: Hosted in Asia
items.body: Postgres in Singapore (AWS ap-southeast-1), close to Kerala for fast pages on 4G.

cta.title: See it with your own hostel's numbers
cta.body: Start with the sample hostel, then switch to an empty one when you're ready.

features.ai: Ask StayOS, in English and Malayalam

faq.a: Nothing is charged automatically. Pick a plan in Settings to keep going; your data stays as it is.

faq.q: Do residents and parents pay for the app?
faq.a: No. The resident and parent apps are free for them. You pay one price for the hostel.

faq.q: How do UPI payments reach me?
faq.a: Straight to your own UPI ID or bank account. StayOS only reads the payment to match it to the invoice.

faq.q: Can I move from my register or Excel?
faq.a: Yes. Start empty, add rooms by block and floor, then add residents. Bulk import from Excel is on the way.

payments.title: Rent payments
payments.body: Connect the hostel's own Razorpay account. Residents and parents then pay rent by UPI or card, the money goes straight to your bank, and each invoice is marked paid by itself.
payments.step1: Sign in at dashboard.razorpay.com (create a free account if you don't have one).
payments.step2: Go to Account & Settings → API Keys and generate a key. Test mode keys (rzp_test_) let you try it without real money.
payments.step3: Paste the Key ID and Key Secret below.
payments.safety: The secret is checked with Razorpay, then stored encrypted. Nobody can read it back, including you and us.
payments.liveNote: Live: residents pay real money into your account.
payments.testNote: Test mode: payments use Razorpay's test UPI and cards, no real money moves.
payments.webhookBody: In Razorpay, go to Account & Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook, and enter these. Without it, payments go through but invoices aren't marked paid.
payments.webhookHint: Set it up separately in test and live mode: each mode has its own webhooks in Razorpay.
payments.unavailable: Online payments aren't set up on this site.
